title: Conventional ML reference layer
summary: The conventional-ML layer includes provenance-aware immutable datasets, scaling, exact/reference and ridge regression, iterative gradient linear regression, centroid/k-NN classification, and dev7 logistic regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, decision trees, deterministic k-means and PCA.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Domain packages consume ooRexx Maths instead of private matrix numerics.
Reference algorithms prioritize semantic correctness, replay and evidence over maximum speed.
Iterative estimator continuation keeps optimizer/session state outside private model internals.
Numerical upgrades must not change object/history semantics.
procedure: Use MLDataset with explicit identity/provenance for evidence-grade training.
Use closed-form/iterative regression, classification, clustering and PCA reference objects according to task semantics; do not flatten them into disposable wrappers.
Treat every fitted estimator/transform as a driveable historical object and branch policy alternatives from retained checkpoints.
Use validation evidence and retained-branch comparison before selecting a future.
Accelerated providers may replace execution only when model/provenance/history semantics remain observationally equivalent.

provenance.claim: dev7 conventional technique expansion: logistic regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Gini decision tree, deterministic k-means, PCA and technique catalogue.
dev2 conventional ML, dataset provenance, ridge, k-NN, iterative gradient regression and metrics.
